$comment: skyphusion-monitor probe inventory (monitor#42). Adding/changing a surface is an edit HERE (validated in CI by tests/config.test.ts, shipped by the tagged deploy) -- never a src/ edit. Schema: src/validate.ts CheckConfig. POST-FLEET REBUILD 2026-09-25: the Hetzner fleet was cut 2026-09-24 and every surface it served is gone, so this inventory was re-derived from live measurement rather than edited by recollection. Each hostname below was resolved against TWO independent resolvers (1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8) and probed anonymously from off-CF on 2026-09-25; nothing is listed on memory alone. REMOVED as dead (9 checks, 7 NXDOMAIN hostnames plus one dangling record): authentik (auth.skyphusion.org), ntfy (ntfy.skyphusion.org), analytics-tracker + F2.analytics-access (analytics.skyphusion.org), F2.chat-access (chat.skyphusion.org), F2.chatplus-access (chat-plus.skyphusion.org), F2.search-access (search.skyphusion.org), F2.grafana-access (grafana.skyphusion.org) -- all NXDOMAIN on both resolvers; and status-gatus (status.skyphusion.org), whose DNS record still resolves but whose origin is gone (CF 530). A check against a dead hostname is not a dormant check, it is a guaranteed permanent failure, and a permanently failing board is how a real outage gets lost in the noise. ADDED, each measured live before listing: common-thread (200, real app; it was removed at fc#1194 while NXDOMAIN and the hostname is answering again, so the fc#1194 removal note is now historical), postern-demo/postern-apex/postern-www (the public posternonline.com demo zone, apex and www both 301 to demo), and vivijure-panel (the panel shell root, 200, same public-shell-with-self-authing-API shape as studio-shell). Deliberately absent: monitor.skyphusion.org (self-probe is circular), *.workers.dev (see workersDev below), imap./smtp. (TCP), rockenhaus.org (parked). NOTE on /health: internal Gatus at status.skyphusion.org was the only consumer of this Worker's /health endpoint and it died with the fleet, so /health is no longer a monitored control. Monitor liveness now rests entirely on the HC_CRON_PING_URL dead-man (HC.io pages on absence of a cron ping). VANTAGE LIMIT, MEASURED not inferred (fc#1194, 2026-08-01): this Worker CANNOT probe any *.workers.dev hostname. Cloudflare blocks Worker-to-workers.dev subrequests inside the same account and answers 404 `error code: 1042` for every such name, ENABLED and DISABLED alike, with https://skyphusion.org/ as a control returning a real 200 through the same code path. Those probes are REPLACED by the COVER.workers-dev check, which reads authoritative state from the Cloudflare API for EVERY Worker in the account (see workersDev below and src/coverage.ts).

workersDev.$comment: ALLOWANCE policy for the COVER.workers-dev check (fc#1194 / fc#1180 F2). The Worker LIST is derived from the Cloudflare API at runtime, never from this file -- a Worker deployed tomorrow is assessed the moment it exists, and a Worker nobody remembers is assessed too. This list is only the set of Workers permitted to answer on *.workers.dev. Rules enforced by src/coverage.ts: an ENABLED Worker with no entry FAILS; an entry whose Worker is no longer enabled FAILS (a stale allowance must not rot into a permanent silent pass); an entry naming a Worker that does not exist FAILS; a zero-length enumeration FAILS (an empty success is indistinguishable from a permission gap, fc#1180 F5); a non-boolean previews_enabled FAILS as UNKNOWN. An entry here RECORDS an exposure, it does not bless it: workers.dev is not covered by Cloudflare Access, which binds a hostname, so each of these depends on the Worker's own code staying correct forever with no platform gate behind it. Disabling any of these live hostnames is Conrad-gated (fc#1180 F1 precedent: unknown dependants). UNVERIFIED SINCE THE FLEET CUT: this list was last reconciled against the account on 2026-08-15 and no seat currently holds a Workers-Scripts-Read token, so whether all four scripts still exist is UNKNOWN. It is deliberately left unchanged rather than trimmed on a guess: an entry naming a missing script FAILS LOUDLY, which is the correct outcome for an unverified allowance, whereas silently deleting entries would manufacture a pass. Re-reconcile in the same change that provisions CF_WORKERS_READ_TOKEN.
